title: Exactness and full faithfulness at finite level
statement:
For finite $\Lambda$, $\nu_T^*$ is exact, its unit

$$
 F\longrightarrow\nu_{T,*}\nu_T^*F
$$

is an isomorphism for every etale $\Lambda$-module sheaf, and

$$
 R^q\nu_{T,*}\nu_T^*I=0\qquad(q>0)
$$

for every injective etale $\Lambda$-module sheaf $I$.

proof.text: By [def-weil-pbc-site-comparison-morphism], the module inverse image preserves finite limits and is a left adjoint. Kernels are finite limits, and cokernels are coequalizers of a map and zero; thus it preserves both. The module operations in that definition show that the functor is additive, so it is exact.

Let $v:W\to T$ be any affine etale object. By [lem-weil-pbc-comparison-pullback], restriction of $\nu_T^*F$ to $W_{\Proet}$ is $\nu_W^*(v^{-1}F)$. Apply [lem-weil-pbc-comparison-sections] with affine base $X=W$ and the singleton inverse system $U=W$: its sections on $W$ are $(v^{-1}F)(W)=F(W)$, since etale restriction is restriction to the slice. The unit sends $s\in F(W)$ to the comma-colimit representative $(W,\mathrm{id}_W,s)$ in [def-weil-pbc-site-comparison-morphism]; the displayed section identification sends this representative back to $s$. Therefore the unit is bijective on every affine etale object. Restriction to the affine etale site is an equivalence by [lem-weil-pbc-affine-etale-site-topos], hence detects isomorphisms of underlying abelian sheaves and therefore of module sheaves.

proof.text:
Fix injective $I$ and an affine etale $v:W	o T$. By [lem-weil-pbc-etale-restriction-injectives], $v^{-1}I$ is injective on $W_{\Et}$. By [lem-weil-pbc-comparison-pullback], $(
u_T^*I)|_{W_{\Proet}}\cong
u_W^*(v^{-1}I)$. The object $W/W$ belongs to $\mathcal B_W$ of [def-weil-pbc-ind-etale-basis], since its identity ring map is etale and hence ind-etale. Apply [lem-weil-pbc-comparison-injective-acyclicity] with affine base $W$ and basis object $W/W$. It gives $H^q(W_{\Proet},(
u_T^*I)|_W)=0$ for every $q>0$.

source.place: ## Proof, third paragraph: restrict to an affine etale object and apply affine vanishing

proof.text:
Put $G=
u_T^*I$. The small-site module category is Grothendieck by [lem-weil-pbc-ring-sheaves-grothendieck], so [lem-sp-grothendieck-enough-injectives] supplies a module injective resolution $G	o J^ ullet$. By [def-sp-left-exact-additive], $R^q
u_{T,*}G=\mathcal H^q(
u_{T,*}J^ ullet)$. By [def-weil-pbc-site-comparison-morphism], $(
u_{T,*}J^n)(W)=J^n(W)$. Kernels are sectionwise and cokernels are sheafified sectionwise cokernels by [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]; consequently this cohomology sheaf is the sheafification of $W\mapsto H^q(J^ ullet(W))$. By [lem-weil-pbc-proetale-restriction-injectives], this last group is $H^q(W_{\Proet},G|_W)$. Step 3 makes it zero on every affine etale $W$ when $q>0$. Every section of this sheafification is locally represented by a section of the presheaf; refine those neighborhoods by affine etale objects, where all representatives are zero. Thus the sheafification is zero locally, and the affine-etale equivalence [lem-weil-pbc-affine-etale-site-topos] gives $R^q
u_{T,*}G=0$.
